The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the
Recreation Commission with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Monday of every month at 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the Community Services Department via email at
kshigenaga@cityofsanmarino.org or by phone at (626) 300­0791 at least 48 hours prior to
the meeting.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do its best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Commissioner Tam, Commissioner Tsai, Commissioner Wu, Vice Chair Solan, and Chair Yen

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Recreation
Commission on any item of interest that is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the
Recreation Commission. Pursuant to state law, the Recreation Commission may not discuss or
take action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The
Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to
follow up on such items.

COMMISSIONER REPORTS

This is an opportunity for members of the Recreation Commission to inform the public and
staff of any meetings, events, or conferences they may have attended. In addition,
Commissioners may provide feedback related to program and service offerings.

  NEW BUSINESS

1.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Commission approve the minutes of the
  regular meeting of November 13, 2023. If the Commission concurs with staff’s
  recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve the minutes of the regular meeting of November 13, 2023.”

2.  DIRECTOR AND RECREATION MANAGER REPORT
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Commission receive and file the Director and
  Recreation Manager Report. If the Commission concurs with staff’s recommendation,
  an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Director and Recreation Manager Report.”

3.  4TH OF JULY PARADE MANAGEMENT
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Commission provide feedback to staff on
  the proposal for the City to continue the 4th of July parade, and consideration of the
  parade’s start time for staff to discuss with the City Council. If the Commission
  concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to support the recommendation of this proposal to the Recreation
  Commission Council Liaisons.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the Recreation Commission. All public writings distributed by the City
of San Marino to at least a majority of the Recreation Commission regarding any item on this
agenda will be made available at the Stoneman Building located at 1560 Pasqualito Drive,
San Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the Recreation Commission meeting.

ADJOURNMENT

MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO RECREATION COMMISSION
  MONDAY, FEBRUARY 12, 2024 AT 6:00 P.M.
  BARTH ROOM, CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY

CALL TO ORDER: Chair Yen called the regular meeting to order at 6:07 p.m. in the Barth Room,
located at 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108 and Renaissance Walnut
Creek Hotel Lobby, located at 2805 Jones Road, Walnut Creek, California 94597.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Chair Yen led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL:  PRESENT: Commissioner Tam (via teleconference), Commissioner Wu,
  Vice Chair Solan, and Chair Yen

  ABSENT: Commissioner Tsai

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

COMMISSIONER REPORTS

No reports were given at this time.

NEW BUSINESS

1. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Commissioner Wu moved, seconded by Vice Chair Solan, to approve the minutes of the regular
meeting of November 13, 2023.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Commissioner Tam, Commissioner Wu, Vice Chair Solan, and Chair Yen
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Commissioner Tsai

2. DIRECTOR AND RECREATION MANAGER REPORT

Director Johnson and Recreation Manager Covarrubias presented the staff report.
 RECREATION COMMISSION MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
FEBRUARY 12, 2024  PAGE 2 OF 2

The following person(s) provided comment:
  None

3.  4TH  OF JULY PARADE MANAGEMENT

Director Johnson presented the staff report.

The Commission discussed the logistics of the parade, including staff and volunteer resources, parade
route and end location, and pros and cons of different parade start times.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  None

Commissioner Wu moved, seconded by Commissioner Tam, to support the recommendation of
this proposal to the Recreation Commission Council Liaisons.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Commissioner Tam, Commissioner Wu, Vice Chair Solan, and Chair Yen
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Commissioner Tsai

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

The following person(s) provided written communications or public writings:
  None

ADIOURNMENT

Chair Yen adjourned the meeting at 7:47 p.m.
